title: Story premise ENT081: The Draft That Ate the Deadline
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (creative-work struggles). Hook: The draft has grown legs. Takeaway/theme: Choosing what to finish can matter more than generating more options.
description: An animator wants to finish a short scene, but each new idea physically adds another page to a growing paper creature. They choose one page with the clearest action, park the rest in a labeled NEXT TIME box, and finish the scene while the creature curls up for a nap.
